# tfcensus report

report reads JSON files that earlier runs wrote and renders them, offline: no AWS call, no
terragrunt and no state read. report html builds one static HTML page. The other subcommands
print the same summaries as the tools of tfcensus mcp, with the same filters.

## Usage

```sh
tfcensus report <command>
```

The [global flags](/cli/global-flags) work with every command.

## Examples

```sh
tfcensus report scan --from scan.json --category unmanaged
tfcensus report html --from scan.json --from drift.json -o census.html
```

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [tfcensus report audit](/cli/report/audit) | List the findings of a saved backend audit, highest severity first |
| [tfcensus report drift](/cli/report/drift) | Summarize a saved drift run: unit statuses and drifted resources |
| [tfcensus report html](/cli/report/html) | Write a static HTML report from scan, drift and audit JSON |
| [tfcensus report inventory](/cli/report/inventory) | Count the managed resources of a saved state index per unit and type |
| [tfcensus report scan](/cli/report/scan) | Summarize a saved scan: counts and the top unmanaged resources |
| [tfcensus report units](/cli/report/units) | List the units of a saved state index |
